about_the_game:
Gamestory

Trapped in an office, immobilized in a chair, you face a terrifying reality. Two doors and a window are the potential entry points for a demon that relentlessly hunts you. Your only ally is a computer, your gateway to a labyrinthine network of secrets and dangers.

Through cameras, the Tor browser, and hidden websites, you are called upon to unravel the mystery that surrounds you and escape the nightmare. You have only SIX DAYS at your disposal to reach the truth, solving puzzles and searching in the dark corners of the internet.

Your fight for survival will not be easy. The demon lurks, ready to devour you. Monitor the cameras with a watchful eye to spot it, close the doors wisely, and manage your energy carefully.

Key Features

  • Immersive and Terrifying Setting
  • Strategic Gameplay Mechanics
  • Resource and Energy Management
  • Auditory Horror and Jump Scares

Immersive and Terrifying Setting
Players are trapped in an office, immobilized in a chair, facing a demon that relentlessly hunts them. The game’s atmosphere is designed to evoke intense fear and suspense.

Strategic Gameplay Mechanics
Utilize a computer to navigate a labyrinthine network of secrets and dangers. Players must use cameras, the Tor browser, and hidden websites to unravel the mystery, solve puzzles, and manage their survival over six days.



Resource and Energy Management
Carefully monitor and close doors to keep the demon at bay, while managing energy reserves. Each action must be calculated to ensure survival against the relentless threat.

Auditory Horror and Jump Scares
The game features sudden terrifying appearances and sound-based horror elements. Players must remain vigilant, as sound cues play a crucial role in survival, filling the environment with nerve-wracking messages and warnings.

Footnotes

Prepare for sudden appearances that will take your breath away. Sound will become your worst enemy, filling your ears with terrifying messages.

Will you manage to escape the nightmare? Or will you be lost forever in the darkness?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4 Cores
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 4+ Cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Above GeForce GTX 1080 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Survive six nights of terror in a deadly cat-and-mouse game. Immobilized in a chair, solve intricate puzzles, monitor cameras, and scour the dark web to uncover secrets—all while a relentless demon hunts you. Will you outsmart the darkness before time runs out?
